label: r4c6
name: Narrow deep trunk (24x6)
hypothesis: A 24-wide trunk with 6 residual 3x3 convs costs about 0.7 of the starting network, so it keeps the full 131k samples. With the 5x5 head its receptive field covers the whole grid several times over. The deeper stack can build up multi-step features such as landing layers and sealed gaps. If dev falls clearly below 0.135, width matters more than depth at this budget.
